title: Lateness and Punctuality Standard
summary: Standard resumption is 8:00 AM. Therapists must be present, prepared, and ready to work. Lateness without prior approval or a valid reason attracts a 0.1% remuneration deduction.

sections.title: Standard Resumption Time
paragraphs: The standard resumption time at Zura Spa is 8:00 AM. All therapists are expected to be present, prepared, and ready to begin their duties at this time.

sections.title: Standard for Lateness
paragraphs: Any therapist who arrives after 8:00 AM without prior approval or a valid reason will be regarded as late. Lateness attracts a deduction of 0.1% of the therapist's remuneration.

Therapists are expected to plan their schedules and transportation ahead of time to avoid preventable delays. Where an unavoidable circumstance may cause lateness, the therapist should communicate with management as early as possible.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset Towards Punctuality
paragraphs: Punctuality should be viewed as a professional responsibility and part of the Zura Spa standard, not simply as a personal choice.

Every therapist should have the mindset that being on time means being ready to work. Arriving at 8:00 AM should not mean arriving at the premises and then beginning to prepare; therapists should make adequate arrangements to be ready for their duties at the resumption time.

Punctuality demonstrates discipline and personal responsibility, respect for colleagues and management, commitment to Zura Spa and its standards, consideration for clients and the smooth flow of operations, and professionalism and readiness to serve.

Therapists are therefore expected to take punctuality seriously and avoid developing a habit of arriving late. Consistent punctuality helps create a reliable, organized, and professional workplace culture.
At Zura Spa, punctuality is not optional—it is part of our standard.

remember: Be present, prepared, and ready at 8:00 AM. Punctuality is not optional — it is part of the Zura Spa standard.
